formulas.absolute_score: sum over criteria of (score / max_score) * weight
formulas.benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all suppliers in the run
formulas.gap: score - benchmark (0 for the benchmark leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_pct: score / benchmark * 100; if benchmark == 0 then 0 (no supplier showed evidence, no peer credit)

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The proposal offers a robust technical architecture with event-driven Kafka ingestion, Delta Lake lakehouse, and pre-built certified connectors for key systems like SAP S/4HANA and Coupa. Scalability and resilience are strongly supported by AKS auto-scaling, tested latency under 1.8 seconds for 2,000 concurrent users, and low RPO/RTO targets.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Architecture: event-driven ingestion using Kafka connectors...Pre-built, certified connectors for SAP S/4HANA...All integrations are bidirectional with retry queues and dead-letter handling....load tested to 50 million spend lines and 2,000 concurrent users with p95 dashboard latency under 1.8 seconds. Multi-region disaster recovery with RPO 15 minutes and RTO 2 hours.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The 20-week implementation plan is clear and structured with specific milestones across 5 phases. Staffing is comprehensive with a 9 FTE peak team and an experienced named solution architect, accompanied by weekly risk management and proactive sandbox risk mitigations.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Discovery & architecture sign-off Weeks 1-3 Solution design approved...Go-live & hypercare Weeks 19-20 Production go-live...Team: Engagement lead, solution architect, 2 data engineers, 2 integration engineers, security engineer, BI developer, QA analyst (9 FTE at peak). Named architect: Dr. Lena Moravec (12 years data platforms)....[Page 2] Key risk: delayed sandbox access - mitigated by mock data contracts from week 1.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is transparently broken down across software, implementation, integrations, security, training, and support totaling $1,340,000. However, recurring cloud infrastructure costs are excluded, adding approximately $6,500 monthly, and out-of-scope changes are billed at $1,650/day.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Platform licence (3 years) $540,000...Total $1,340,000...[Page 2] Prices exclude Azure consumption, estimated at $6,500/month....Fixed price for listed scope; change requests billed at $1,650/day.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Security and compliance measures are exceptional, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, SOC 2 Type II report, and strong encryption standards. Comprehensive governance features include customer-managed keys, 7-year immutable audit logging, GDPR processing agreements, and quarterly pen testing.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (certificate IS-778120) and SOC 2 Type II report (Dec 2025) available under NDA....AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault....Immutable audit logs retained for 7 years; GDPR data processing agreement and EU data residency.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: Apex shows strong relevant experience having delivered 11 procurement analytics platforms with two verifiable enterprise references provided. However, the standard support tier is restricted to CET business hours with a 4-hour P1 SLA, requiring an optional add-on for 24x7 coverage.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: Business-hours support (08:00-18:00 CET) with 4-hour response for P1 incidents; 24x7 available as an add-on....Delivered 11 procurement analytics platforms since 2019, including for a European grocery chain (9,000 suppliers) and a logistics group....Helvetia Foods AG - Head of Procurement Analytics (contact on request)...TransEuro Logistics - CIO office (contact on request)

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above NexaWorks: higher PPI (97.37 vs 96.84).
risks: Azure infrastructure consumption is excluded from total price and adds an estimated $6,500 per month ($234,000 over 3 years).
Delivery timeline relies on Northwind providing SAP and Coupa sandbox access by week 3.
Standard support SLA is limited to business hours (08:00-18:00 CET) with a 4-hour P1 incident response time, requiring additional cost for 24x7 coverage.
Out-of-scope work and scope changes carry an additional commercial cost of $1,650 per day.
suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems delivers a technically sound, well-structured proposal with proven integrations, strong security credentials (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and deep domain experience across 11 similar implementations. Primary considerations include excluded Azure cloud hosting costs ($6,500/month), dependency on early sandbox environment access, and business-hours-only baseline support.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The technical architecture is well articulated, leveraging AWS services, standard connectors for SAP and Coupa, and REST APIs. Scalability is proven up to 20 million spend lines with concurrency scaling available for larger volumes.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Solution: NexaInsight platform on AWS (Redshift, Glue, QuickSight embedded) with standard connectors for SAP S/4HANA and Coupa, and a documented REST API for further integrations. Scales to 20 million spend lines in our current benchmark; larger volumes use Redshift concurrency scaling.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The implementation plan features a clear 22-week phased schedule, an 8 FTE team structure with a named PMP project manager, and a concrete risk governance approach. Clear milestone gates and training targets are defined throughout delivery.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Phase 0 - Mobilisation Weeks 1-2 Project charter, RACI, risk register baseline...Phase 4 - Go-live & hypercare Weeks 19-22 Go-live wk 19, hypercare to wk 22...Team: Delivery director (steering), full-time project manager, solution architect, 2 data engineers, BI developer, test lead, change & training lead (8 FTE). Named PM: Samuel Okafor, PMP, 7 similar programmes....[Page 2] Risk management: • Weekly risk and issue review with the steering committee; top risks with owners and dates.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is transparently itemized with a fixed total implementation and licensing fee of $895,000 alongside structured milestone payments. However, AWS infrastructure consumption is an estimate billed at cost, introducing potential operating cost variability.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Total $895,000...Assumptions: • AWS consumption estimated at $4,200/month and billed at cost. • Fixed price covers the listed scope; 10% contingency held for agreed change requests. • Milestone-based payments: 20% / 30% / 30% / 20%.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Strong data protection controls, KMS encryption, TLS 1.2+, SAML 2.0 SSO, and GDPR compliance are detailed. However, SOC 2 Type II certification is still in progress and will not be finalized until Q3 2026.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] • SOC 2 Type I report available; SOC 2 Type II audit window in progress (report due Q3 2026). • Encryption at rest (AWS KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.2+); SSO via SAML 2.0. • Role-based access by business unit; audit logging of all user and admin actions. • GDPR DPA provided; data hosted in AWS eu-west-1.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The proposal offers 24x7 support with aggressive SLAs, hypercare, and dedicated account management. Demonstrated domain expertise is supported by six similar retail implementations and two named references.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: 24x7 support with contractual SLAs: P1 response 30 minutes / restore 4 hours, P2 response 2 hours. Dedicated technical account manager, monthly service reports, 90-day hypercare, and a knowledge-transfer plan so Northwind can self-serve new dashboards....Relevant experience: Six procurement analytics implementations in retail and consumer goods since 2020....References: • Baltic Home Retail - Procurement Director, Maria Lind • GreenLeaf Consumer Goods - Head of Data, Arun Patel

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above Orbit Digital: higher PPI (96.84 vs 59.66).
risks: SOC 2 Type II certification is currently pending with audit completion scheduled for Q3 2026, posing an interim compliance risk.
AWS hosting consumption is billed at cost based on an estimated $4,200 per month, introducing potential budget variance if spend volume grows.
suppliers.overall_summary: NexaWorks delivers a robust, well-structured proposal with strong technical fit on AWS, dedicated project staffing, clear fixed-scope commercial terms, and solid retail procurement analytics experience. The principal watch items are the pending SOC 2 Type II audit and variable cloud consumption charges.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The platform is hosted on Google Cloud and supports enterprise data volumes, but the proposal defers integration architecture and connectors entirely to post-contract discovery. It provides minimal architectural or technical detail regarding system interoperability.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] OrbitSpend will integrate with Northwind's existing systems as needed; the integration approach and connectors will be finalised during the discovery phase. The platform is hosted on Google Cloud and supports enterprise data volumes.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: A high-level 24-week schedule with milestones is outlined, but team sizing is deferred until after discovery. Furthermore, the risk plan is superficial, merely stating that standard risk management applies without identifying specific project risks.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Phase Timing Milestone Discovery Weeks 1-6 Requirements confirmed Implementation Weeks 7-20 Platform configured Go-live Weeks 21-24 Go-live...Team: Account director, project manager and consultants from our retail practice, sized after discovery....Standard project risk management applies.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: Pricing is structured with line items, but both integration and implementation fees are variable estimates that depend on discovery outcomes. Additional unbudgeted travel expenses create commercial uncertainty and risk of cost escalation.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Total $965,000 (estimate)...Assumptions: • Integration and implementation costs are estimates until discovery is complete. • Travel expenses billed separately.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Orbit Digital confirms ISO/IEC 27001 certification, encryption in transit and at rest, and SSO integration in European cloud regions. However, specific details on privacy frameworks, data residency guarantees, and audit logging are omitted.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] ISO/IEC 27001 certified. Data encrypted at rest and in transit. • SSO supported. Hosted in Google Cloud europe-west regions.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The supplier demonstrates deep retail industry experience, an industry award, and three named client references with contact details. However, the support model is limited to business hours with a relatively slow 8-hour critical response window.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: Business-hours support with 8-hour response for critical issues; customer success reviews twice a year....Relevant experience: Over 40 procurement analytics deployments since 2011, including 12 retailers with more than $1B annual spend....Nordic Fashion Group - CPO, Erik Johansson (+46 8 555 0101)...Maple Grocers Canada - VP Procurement, Diane Chen (+1 416 555 0144)...Iberia Home Stores - Procurement Excellence Lead, Pablo Ruiz (+34 91 555 0199)

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above BrightPath Tech: higher PPI (59.66 vs 39.26).
risks: Implementation and integration fees are non-binding estimates, exposing the buyer to potential budget overruns after discovery.
Technical integration design and connectors are undefined and deferred to the discovery phase.
Staffing capacity is not locked down upfront and will only be sized following discovery.
Critical incident response time is up to 8 business hours, which may be inadequate during peak retail trading windows.
Risk management methodology lacks concrete identification of delivery hazards and mitigation steps.
suppliers.overall_summary: Orbit Digital demonstrates extensive retail experience with over 40 deployments, notable references, and core ISO/IEC 27001 compliance. However, the proposal carries material delivery and commercial risk because technical integration, staffing plans, and over $400k in service and integration fees are left as unfinalized estimates subject to discovery.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The proposed BrightBoard solution lacks essential enterprise features, relying on weekly manual CSV uploads while live SAP integration is only on the roadmap. Furthermore, the platform is restricted to a single cloud region and performance testing on Northwind's data volume has not been conducted.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "We will deploy our BrightBoard SaaS product, pre-configured with standard procurement dashboards."...[Page 1] "Data is loaded from CSV exports that Northwind uploads weekly; an API connector for SAP is on our roadmap."...[Page 1] "The platform runs on a single-region cloud deployment and is suitable for most mid-sized customers."...[Page 1] "Performance testing for Northwind's data volume has not yet been carried out."

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The proposal provides a high-level 12-week schedule with three phases, but implementation staffing is minimal with only a part-time project manager and two consultants. Crucially, the vendor explicitly failed to provide any risk management plan.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Kick-off & data upload"...[Page 1] "Dashboard configuration"...[Page 1] "Training & go-live"...[Page 1] "Team: Project manager (part-time) and 2 consultants."...[Page 1] "Risk management:"...[Page 1] "Not provided."

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: BrightPath Tech presents a clear fixed pricing structure totaling $370,000 across subscription, setup, and training. However, the commercial value is compromised by exclusions such as SSO and enterprise support, along with shifting the data preparation burden to Northwind and charging extra for custom dashboards and connectors.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] "Total"...[Page 1] "$370,000"...[Page 1] "• CSV exports are prepared and cleaned by Northwind."...[Page 1] "• Additional connectors and custom dashboards are quoted separately."

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Security controls are inadequate for an enterprise deployment, offering only basic password login while SSO requires a costly enterprise tier. Additionally, ISO 27001 is not currently certified (planned for 2027), statements on encryption are vague, and auditability or privacy measures are omitted.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: The vendor was founded recently in 2024 and lacks experience with large retailers, having only executed two small projects with fewer than 200 suppliers. Support is limited to best-effort business-hour email without phone support or uptime SLAs, and no named customer references were provided in the proposal.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] "Support: Email support during business hours (US Eastern time), best-effort response."...[Page 2] "Phone support, named account management and uptime SLAs are only available on the enterprise tier, which is not part of this offer."...[Page 2] "Relevant experience: BrightPath Tech was founded in 2024. We have completed two dashboard projects for small e-commerce companies, each with fewer than 200 suppliers and a single business unit. We have not yet delivered for a retailer of Northwind's size"...[Page 2] "References:"...[Page 2] "• References available on request."
